g.text: Class Diagram (Design) - VIS07 Perspective Camera Interaction
Holds no reference to the camera or modules.
Reused unchanged. positionCamera() gives a default
framing, replaced by VIS07 at build time (ALN-3).
resize() keeps camera.aspect = canvas w / h
(VIS07 detects the change on the next frame).
VIS02 BR 12: never touches the camera.
build(): return if signal aborted or disposed;
the camera position and target (BR 8). Never React state.
- mouseButtons = { LEFT: PAN, MIDDLE: DOLLY, RIGHT: ROTATE }
(no "change" listener: limits are applied per frame)
update() - every frame, before render (D4, D6):
maxDistance, move camera closer along the SAME
(native controls.reset() NOT used: keeps inertia, D10).
+computeFitDistance(dimensions, aspect: number, azimuth: number, polar: number): number
+computeCameraLimits(dimensions: { width, depth, height }, aspect: number, wall?: KitchenWall): CameraLimits
8 corners c = (+-w/2, 0 | h, +-d/2); u = unit vector
right / up = camera axes; vFov = 50 deg,
targetBounds = x in [-w/2, w/2], z in [-d/2, d/2]
Clamps target x/z; moves the camera by the
same correction (no jump, no jitter, D4).
